messages:
jamie: Quick note: scheduling a reserved-pool preflight dry-run this Fri 02:00-04:00 UTC. Goal: exercise fallback routing logic and autoscaler guardrails without changing customer-visible weights. TL;DR: simulate enterprise load, validate fallback behavior, verify alerts + rollback playbook.

ash: Why a dry-run vs. a real canary?

jamie: We won't change live routing weights. Instead we'll run a targeted load test that tags requests as enterprise and route via a test-only steering rule that mirrors traffic to reserved pool (mirror-only 70% extra traffic). This tests path and caches without impacting production routing.

kevin: Mirror rule example for proxy:
```
route "enterprise-mirror-test" {
  match: header(x-tenant-tier) == "enterprise"
  mirror: pool("reserved-enterprise-pool")
  mirror_rate: 0.7
}
```
I'll push config under feature flag and roll to 3 proxies in us-west first.

maria: Observability items: - synthetic client probes with enterprise headers from us-east/us-west/eu-central - enable 100% trace sampling for mirrored requests for 30m - create a 'mirror-p99' dashboard and add alert (p99 > 260ms for 5m).

leo: Autoscaler note: mirrored load doesn't trigger scale by default. Kevin, can you enable prewarm hook so reserved pool sees the load as real? We want to test scale behavior too.

kevin: Good call. Will enable prewarm and set autoscale.override=true for the test. Will also set min_instances +15% for 01:40 UTC.

deploy-bot: Maintenance scheduled: reserved-pool-preflight-dryrun by jamie on 2398765432 (Fri 02:00-04:00 UTC). Notified: eng-sre, eng-runtime, eng-infra, product.

jamie: Loadtest command (run from loadtest cluster, tag responses with enterprise header):
```
./tools/loadtest --route mirror --duration 25m --qps 400 --header "x-tenant-tier: enterprise" --tag reserved-preflight-2024
```
We'll do one global run at 02:10 and a second targeted run at 03:00 against eu-central.

maria: Runbook additions: - soft trigger: mirror-p99 > 240ms for 3m -> pause mirror and run diag. - hard trigger: mirror-p99 > 300ms for 5m OR increased OOMs on reserved pool -> rollback mirror flag. Documented here: https://intranet.redwood/sre/runbooks/reserved-pool-preflight.

ash: If mirror causes cache churn, will we see false positives? How do we filter mirror-only traces from production metrics?

maria: Metrics isolation plan: use metric suffix ".mirror" for all mirrored spans and counters, dashboards will draw comparisons (prod vs mirror). Alerts will only fire on mirror.* to avoid noise.

leo: I'll be on call for autoscaler tweaks. @kevin can you own the proxy rollout and mirror flag?

kevin: Yep, I'll roll proxies and own the flag. Will post PR and link here when ready.

jamie: I'll coordinate exec signal outs and own the post-test summary. Please keep this thread for quick statuses during the window. Short updates only. :white_check_mark:

kevin: PR: https://intranet.redwood/ops/changes/PR-4592 (proxy mirror flag + autoscale override).

maria: Dashboards: https://intranet.redwood/observability/dashboards/mirror-preflight (added alerts and runbook links).

deploy-bot: Reminder 30m: reserved-pool-preflight-dryrun starts in 30 minutes.
